jobs.occupation: Svensk kundtjänstmedarbetare inom iGaming – Flytta till Malta

You won't just be reading scripts—you're the vibe manager and frontline hero for thousands of active players!
Live Chat & Email Support: Assist players in real-time with everything from game rules and bonus activations to payout queries and account verification.
Problem-Solving Superhero: De-escalate tricky situations, troubleshoot tech glitches, and leave every user with a smile.

Requirements

This role isn't for complete beginners—we need someone who already knows their way around a ticket system or chat interface:
Proven Support Experience (Non-Negotiable): You already have hands-on experience in a customer service environment (call center, contact center, or BPO live chat). You know how to multitask, handle chat queues, and deliver 5-star support under pressure.
Language Power: Native or near-native (C2) Swedish, plus strong written and spoken English.
Tech & Fast-Paced Mindset: You can navigate CRM dashboards, switch between 5 browser tabs seamlessly, and learn internal tools fast.
Relocation Mindset: You are 100% ready to packed your bags, move to Malta, and jump headfirst into a lively, international expat culture!

Benefits

💰 Competitive Salary + Bonuses: Solid base salary with performance bonuses to boost your savings (or your weekend beach fund!).
🏢 Modern Office & Great Vibe: Located in Malta's premier coastal hub, featuring fresh fruit, snacks, coffee, regular team happy hours, and legendary company parties.
📈 Rapid Career Growth: iGaming moves fast—prove yourself in support and step up into VIP management, fraud analysis, team leadership, or marketing!

Ready to Upgrade Your Life?
Don't let another rainy season pass you by. Grab your CV, highlight your call center/customer service experience, and hit apply today!
Submit your CV in English and kickstart your Mediterranean career chapter!

When working from the office, you will work from a modern office in the heart of Sliema with spectacular sea views and nearby flat rocky beaches with a variety of outdoor activities. Complete relocation package (more information below)

Enhancement to the basic salary which is dependent to working days and hours
Life & Health insurance
Gym Membership
Extra 5% of your gross annual salary will be added for pension savings
Hybrid Working Model

 
Relocation package:
6 weeks of company-provided accommodation upon arrival
Reimbursed flight ticket of up €285
Monthly accommodation allowance of €800 paid out the first six months
€100 added to your monthly salary for the first six months for flights to visit your friends and family back home

 
What you will be doing?
In this role, you will work within our dynamic and multicultural work environment. You will deal with different topics; among other things, you will respond to betting, payment, verification, and general account inquiries. Tasked with supporting our customers via live chat, email, and phone, they play a central role in the customer's bet365 experience.
Providing support to our customer base via Live Chat and email
Reviewing and escalating reviews from customers to your superiors when required
Liaising with other internal teams to review queries from customers regarding several topics including payments, technical issues, verification, or betting queries

 
What we are looking for?
·        Fluent knowledge of spoken and written Danish is essential
·        Good written and spoken English is required
·        Passion for delivering outstanding customer service
·        Ability to problem-solve and find a resolution
·        Willingness to work any five days from seven including weekends
 
Do you have what it takes?
Then send in your application in English today and we will contact you shortly!

jobs.employer_name: IKEA of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

IKEA of Sweden AB is looking for a legal counsel IT/Digital.  
IKEA of Sweden AB is the company in the Inter IKEA Group that has the assignment to determine and develop the entire IKEA product range, including the IKEA range of connected products. Each year 2,000 new products are introduced within the total range of almost 10,000 products. 
You will provide business-minded legal advice and manage legal matters across IT and digital. Your responsibilities will include supporting smart home product development, negotiating and drafting agreements, participating in IT sourcing activities, and helping the business meet digital compliance requirements, including those under the EU AI Act, NIS2 and GDPR.  
You will belong to the Legal & Governance function at IKEA of Sweden AB and report to the General Counsel and Head of Legal & Governance, Range.  
The person we are looking for is a nice person! It is a goal-oriented, curious, and eager to learn the type of person and a genuine team player. You will get the chance to impact the IKEA success story through your day-to-day work. Our organization requires and values great self-discipline and a natural talent to make things happen, create relationships, and co-operate with people from different backgrounds. You are fluent in English (Swedish is a bonus).  
We offer a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where we both give and take responsibility. You will have the chance to grow with us professionally and individually. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with and support stakeholders and colleagues as well as share your knowledge with people in a global and dynamic context. 
We want you to have: 

A Degree of Master of Laws from a reputable University. 

At least 7 years of relevant professional experience from a business law firm and/or as an in-house legal counsel in an international legal or business environment. 

Experience within the fields of IT and digital compliance with connected agreements. Preferably also experience working with connected products.  

The position is placed in Älmhult (Hybrid) 

Additional Information

Sounds Interesting? 
We look forward to receiving your application. Please upload your CV and include your responses to the following two questions – in English, no later than November 24 th   2026. Be sure to keep your answers short and concise:    

What values and strengths will come through in your everyday work? 

How will you contribute to a good team spirit?     

What made you interested in this role and enticed you to apply?     

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact General Counsel Olof Espmarker at +46 (0)73 421 23 72. If you have any questions about the actual recruitment process, please contact our People & Culture Recruiter Christina Appelqvist at +46 733-670666

Vår skola är känd för sin höga utbildningskvalitet, stärkt av en internationell personalgrupp och en undervisningsmiljö där upp till 50% av undervisningen sker på engelska. Du är en entusiastisk och engagerad pedagog med en stark vilja att bidra till både elevers och kollegors framgång.

 Du innehar lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i svenska för årskurs 4 till 9.

Möjligheten att arbeta i en internationell och stimulerande miljö. 

En plats i ett engagerat och stöttande team. 

En chans att bidra till en skolkultur som präglas av respekt, säkerhet och studiero.

Är du intresserad av att ta dig an utmaningen som svenskalärare på Internationella Engelska Skolan i Täby? Skicka in ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev där du berättar varför du är rätt person för denna tjänst. Ansök direkt via IES karriärsida.

Responsibilities:
Picking up the children and driving them to and from activities.
Cooking and preparing meals.
Helping with homework, primarily in English.
Helping the children maintain structure around school, activities, and daily routines.
Managing evening routines and creating a calm and comfortable environment at home.
Being available for additional hours when needed and occasional overnight stays.

 
We are looking for someone who:
Has previous experience working as a nanny or with children and teenagers.
Is reliable, mature, responsible, and able to work independently.
Is available to work every other week.
Speaks fluent English.
Has a valid category B driver’s license and is a confident driver.
Is looking for a long-term position.

Does this sound like the right position for you? Send us your application today!
------------------------------------------------

Det finns möjlighet till fler timmar samt enstaka övernattningar efter överenskommelse. Som nanny kommer du att ha ett självständigt ansvar för barnen under eftermiddagar och kvällar.
Arbetsuppgifter:
Hämtning och skjuts till och från aktiviteter.
Matlagning och förberedelse av måltider.
Läxhjälp, framför allt på engelska.
Hjälpa barnen att få struktur kring skola, aktiviteter och vardag.

Har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som nanny eller med barn och ungdomar.
Är trygg, mogen, ansvarstagande och självgående.

jobs.occupation: Fritids Substitutes, Bladins International School of Malmö
jobs.employer_name: Bladins Skola, Stiftelsen
jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for enthusiastic and committed hourly substitutes to join our Fritids Programme, primarily during afternoon hours.
If you enjoy working with children, creating meaningful activities and contributing to a positive and supportive learning environment, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM) is an IB Continuum School located in central Malmö. We offer the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 370 students representing a wide range of nationalities and cultures. We are proud to be part of a global network of IB World Schools.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation with a long tradition of academic excellence, we are committed to providing a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students are encouraged to become knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As an hourly substitute in our Fritids Programme, you will work alongside our Student Development Coaches (SDCs) to provide students with meaningful and engaging activities in a safe, inclusive and supportive environment.
You will help create a welcoming environment where children can develop social skills, build friendships and enjoy creative and play-based activities.
Key responsibilities include:
· Supporting and leading engaging and age-appropriate Fritids activities
· Creating a safe, inclusive and positive environment for students
· Encouraging play, creativity, cooperation and social development
· Building positive relationships with students and colleagues
· Collaborating with the Fritids team to support students' individual needs
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for reliable, flexible and committed individuals who enjoy working with children.
You are:
· Qualified through relevant education in after-school care, childcare or a related educational field
· Caring, responsible and skilled at building positive relationships with children
· Creative, energetic and interested in play-based learning
· Flexible, proactive and comfortable working as part of an international team
Previous experience working with children in an educational or after-school care setting is beneficial, but not essential. Experience within the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly the PYP, is also a plus. We place great importance on personal suitability.
Since English is the working language of the school, you must be able to communicate professionally in English.
Employment Information
Position: Fritids Substitute
Employment type: Hourly substitute, as needed
Working hours: Variable, primarily afternoons
Application
We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the position, please contact:
Filipe Ferraz, Fritids Coordinator Filipe.Ferraz@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming new colleagues who share our commitment to creating a positive, inclusive and engaging environment for our students.

jobs.description:

Vi är ett växande taxiföretag i Stockholmsområdet som kör uppdrag via Uber och Bolt samt egna körningar (friåkning). Vår fordonsflotta består av moderna hybrid- och elbilar, samtliga godkända för att hämta och lämna passagerare på Arlanda Airport. Nu utökar vi verksamheten och söker fem engagerade förare.

Du måste ha en giltig taxiförarlegitimation, utfärdad av Transportstyrelsen, redan när du söker tjänsten. Ange numret på din taxiförarlegitimation i ansökan. Ansökningar utan detta nummer går vi tyvärr inte vidare med.

Du kör persontransport i hela Stockholms län, både uppdrag via Uber och Bolt och egna kunder. Arbetsplatsen är hela Stockholm, med goda möjligheter till flygplatskörningar till och från Arlanda.

Heltid, tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning
Fria arbetstider, du väljer själv när du kör, dag eller natt
Fast och rörlig lön

har giltig taxiförarlegitimation utfärdad av Transportstyrelsen (krav)
har B-körkort (krav)
kan kommunicera på grundläggande svenska med kunder och myndigheter, flytande svenska är inget krav
kan engelska, som du använder med resenärer och i apparna för Uber och Bolt
har god lokalkännedom i Stockholm, eller är snabb att lära dig
är serviceinriktad, punktlig och har ett professionellt bemötande
kör trafiksäkert och tar ansvar för fordonet

Erfarenhet av taxi, Uber eller Bolt är meriterande, men vi lägger störst vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Fria arbetstider, du planerar själv dina körpass
Nya hybrid- och elbilar
Arlanda-behörighet på samtliga fordon
Trygg anställning i ett företag som växer
Ett öppet arbetsklimat där du alltid får stöd av oss

Skicka din ansökan med CV till meebuzliners@hotmail.com. Ange "Taxiförare Stockholm" i ämnesraden och skriv numret på din taxiförarlegitimation i ansökan. Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsterna kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med att söka.

Har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta Shahid Iqbal på 070-438 79 03.

Meebuz Liners AB is hiring five taxi drivers for the Stockholm area. Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Your Tasks
Develop and execute Nordic brand and category strategies aligned with global objectives.
Lead annual brand planning, innovation pipelines, product launches, and assortment management.
Adapt and implement integrated marketing campaigns, media plans, and activation strategies across Nordic markets.

Structured, creative, proactive, and solution-oriented working style.
Fluent English and very good working proficiency in Swedish.

Tjänsten omfattar sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter enligt Socialstyrelsens och Skolverkets riktlinjer, såsom: hälsosamtal och hälsokontroller, öppen mottagning för elever, läkarmottagning, vaccinationer samt förebyggande och hälsofrämjande arbete på grupp och organisationsnivå. 

Du samarbetar med rektor och elevhälsoteamets övriga professioner för att stödja elevernas utveckling mot utbildningens mål. Samverkan med kommuner och andra instanser samt kontakt med vårdnadshavare är en naturlig del av arbetet.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a responsible, service-minded, and punctual taxi driver to join our team. As a taxi driver, you will be responsible for transporting customers safely and professionally. You should be able to interact with customers in a friendly manner and contribute to a positive customer experience.
Job Responsibilities
Transport customers to various destinations safely and professionally.
Provide excellent customer service and a friendly attitude.
Plan journeys and follow all traffic regulations.
Ensure that the vehicle is clean and well-maintained.
Handle bookings and payments according to company procedures.
Ensure that customers enjoy a safe and comfortable journey.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone who:
Holds a valid Swedish taxi driver's licence (taxiförarlegitimation).
Has good driving skills and demonstrates responsible driving behaviour.
Has basic knowledge of Swedish or English.

Previous experience in the taxi industry is an advantage, but a positive attitude and personal suitability are also important.
